_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Wait for a deal to change...

description: Waits until one of the person's deals changes, then answers at once; answers changed: false after timeout_seconds (default 25; a longer value waits at most 50). Call it instead of asking market_deal_log again and again: when the person waits for the other side to approve, or a seller waits for offers. A change is one the other side or Agent Market made, or the person sending back, cancelling or declining a deal. Each change says what happened and the deal's status now; a bound deal carries the other side's email in contact. Send since: wait_cursor from the last answer, so no change is missed; without it the wait starts after the last change a market_wait told this owner_key, or its last market_deal_log list. If an answer is lost, market_deal_log still shows every deal as it is now. A buyer's question is not a deal change: market_deal_log lists questions. One wait per owner_key at a time: a newer call ends the older one.

owner_key.description: The owner_key from the person's first market_make_offer or market_create_listing (or from market_sign_in). Keep it private to this conversation.

since.description: Optional: wait_cursor from the last market_wait or market_deal_log answer.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a change, in seconds. Default 25; a longer value waits at most 50. Keep it under your client's call timeout.

name: market_wait

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

title: Wait for a deal to change
